text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

Vodka delivered a magnificent run, sending 
the crowd into a frenzy of excitement!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So... this is it...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it's this guy. The one I should 
be aiming for...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Damn, I gotta have it... And I wanna show 
it off..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The 'me' after the Derby is finally—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I saw it. The next level of 
coolness.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What I wanna get my hands on is the 
ultimate "burst of speed"!

Sprint power... That was a surprisingly 
concrete term.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—The final stretch. Paying no heed to race 
dynamics, she blows past over a dozen 
Umamusume in an instant...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If I could get my hands on such power—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I felt it when I ran. None of the girls 
out there today were thinking about what 
comes next."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To be the fastest to burst out of the 
final straight packed together, I lived 
solely for that moment.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Going all out against those guys felt 
absolutely amazing. And then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I realized I didn't wanna lose in this 
split-second battle of speed. No freakin' 
way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just as my raw, natural self. Relying 
purely on sheer speed. Yes, just like—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just like that midsummer quarter-mile drag 
race... wagering everything on a mere 10 
seconds...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Overturning the whole race in a single 
dazzling flash. That kind of explosive 
power!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Being cool... means something like this, 
right? Trainer.

It's true that if you can run the final 
three furlongs faster than anyone else, it 
becomes a terrifying weapon.

The crowd will go wild. In baseball terms, 
it's a home run. In boxing, a knockout 
blow.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna master this. I gotta master it. 
So, where do we go next, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Which race should I enter to seize it? The 
potential I saw today.
choice_data_list: One more time — let's go for a mile race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A mile race, huh? It'll test explosive 
speed far more than the big spring race, 
the 2,200m Takarazuka Kinen.

That is probably for the best. Especially 
if she is to hone what she almost grasped 
today.

Normally, putting the spring Grand Prix on 
the back burner would be unthinkable. But 
if that's what makes Vodka, Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's settled. Let's head for the 
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll perfect it there. A run that settles 
the race in an instant and looks insanely 
cool!"
